plainTranslation: Easy emotional warmth with a gentle spark. Affection and care mesh without strain. Failure mode: under-investing in something quietly lovely. Lean into it.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
note: Synced from authored synastry bundle synastry-authored__19_ (2).json.
summaryDeep: Your feelings and their affection line up in a low-pressure way. Warmth is there when either of you reaches for it. Reach for it; it's freely given here.
tension: The challenge is that both of you may assume the relationship is doing fine because the feelings are there. You care about each other, you enjoy each other, and there may not be much conflict. But that can make it easy to stop reaching for each other. The check-ins happen less often. The compliments stay in your head. The thoughtful gesture never quite happens because you figure they already know how you feel.
advice: Over time, it can be easy to assume the warmth will take care of itself. The connection may still be there, but if neither person is actively showing up for it, something valuable can start to fade into the background. Not because the feelings are gone, but because they are no longer being expressed.
summaryShort: Your feelings and their affection line up in a low-pressure way.
